entities.summary: Anitha Pauldurai is an Indian basketball player from Tamil Nadu. She was the captain of the India women's national basketball team for eight years after making her senior India debut in 2000. She has been conferred with National Civilian Award Padma Shri in 2021. She has been also conferred with Chief Minister State Award in the field of sports by Government of Tamil Nadu in 2013.
